HYG-01_SAPSTAR.title: Default superuser SAP* is unlocked
HYG-01_SAPSTAR.remediation: Lock SAP* in SU01 across all clients and set profile parameter login/no_automatic_user_sapstar = 1.

HYG-01_STD.title: Standard user unlocked
HYG-01_STD.remediation: Lock unused SAP standard accounts (EARLYWATCH, SAPCPIC) in SU01 and rotate default passwords.

HYG-02_SAP_ALL.title: Composite profile SAP_ALL assigned
HYG-02_SAP_ALL.remediation: Remove SAP_ALL from dialog and administrative accounts; use firefighter emergency access instead.

HYG-02_SAP_NEW.title: Upgrade compatibility profile SAP_NEW assigned
HYG-02_SAP_NEW.remediation: Remove SAP_NEW from user master records and transfer required new authorizations into PFCG roles.

HYG-03.title: Dormant unlocked dialog user
HYG-03.remediation: Lock or expire dialog users inactive beyond the policy threshold and review role assignments.

HYG-04.title: Unlocked dialog user never logged on (>30 days since creation)
HYG-04.remediation: Lock unused accounts provisioned over 30 days ago that have no initial logon date (TRDAT).

HYG-05.title: Excessive effective single roles assigned (>12)
HYG-05.remediation: Perform user access review to prune redundant roles from job transfers (privilege creep).

wildcard_tcode.title: Unrestricted transaction access (S_TCODE = *)
wildcard_tcode.remediation: Replace wildcard '*' in S_TCODE with explicit transaction codes in PFCG role menu.

critical_tcodes.title: External OS command execution (SM49)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict SM49 to emergency Basis profiles only.

critical_tcodes.title: External OS command maintenance (SM69)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Remove SM69 from production roles; maintain OS commands via transport.

critical_tcodes.title: ABAP Editor access in production (SE38)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Revoke SE38 in production systems; execute reports via custom transactions.

critical_tcodes.title: RFC destination maintenance (SM59)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict SM59 modification access to core Basis administrators.

critical_tcodes.title: Client administration and change lock settings (SCC4)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict SCC4 to controlled firefighter profiles to prevent opening production clients.

critical_tcodes.title: System profile parameter maintenance (RZ10)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict RZ10 to senior Basis administrators; use RZ11 for display.

critical_tcodes.title: Function Builder test/execution in production (SE37)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Remove SE37 from production users to prevent direct BAPI/RFC invocation.

critical_tcodes.title: ABAP Program Execution (SA38)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Replace blanket SA38 access with dedicated report transactions and program groups.

critical_tcodes.title: General Table Display (SE16N)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict SE16N in production and pair with strict S_TABU_NAM/S_TABU_DIS display controls.

critical_tcodes.title: Direct table view maintenance (SM30)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Replace generic SM30 with custom parameter transactions locked to specific table views.

critical_tcodes.title: Legacy table maintenance (SM31)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Remove SM31 from production dialog roles.

critical_tcodes.title: User Master Maintenance (SU01)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict SU01 to dedicated security administrators and scope by user group (S_USER_GRP).

critical_tcodes.title: User Mass Maintenance (SU10)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict SU10 to senior security administrators.

critical_tcodes.title: Role Maintenance and Profile Generation (PFCG)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Disable role editing in production; transport roles from DEV via STMS.

critical_tcodes.title: Transport Management System (STMS)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Limit STMS import permissions to Basis release management team.

critical_tcodes.title: Background Job Scheduling (SM36)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict SM36 to batch operations staff and prevent scheduling under privileged step users.

critical_tcodes.title: SAP Directories / OS File System Browser (AL11)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Remove AL11 from business roles to protect OS file shares and interface files.

critical_tcodes.title: HTTP/ICF Service Hierarchy Maintenance (SICF)
critical_tcodes.remediation: Restrict SICF service activation to Basis administrators.

critical_auths.title: ABAP Debugger with variable change/replace (S_DEVELOP DEBUG/02)
critical_auths.remediation: Set ACTVT=03 for S_DEVELOP OBJTYPE=DEBUG in production; grant ACTVT=02 only via firefighter.

critical_auths.title: Unrestricted table change across all authorization groups (S_TABU_DIS */02)
critical_auths.remediation: Replace DICBERCLS=* and ACTVT=02 with explicit table authorization groups and display-only (03).

critical_auths.title: Unrestricted authorization profile assignment including SAP_ALL (S_USER_PRO */22)
critical_auths.remediation: Scope S_USER_PRO to specific naming conventions (Z*) and remove ACTVT=22 on wildcard profiles.

critical_auths.title: Unrestricted user master administration across all user groups (S_USER_GRP *)
critical_auths.remediation: Restrict CLASS to non-privileged user groups so administrators cannot modify SUPER/BASIS accounts.

critical_auths.title: Unrestricted role modification across all roles (S_USER_AGR */02)
critical_auths.remediation: Set S_USER_AGR to display (03) in production or scope ACT_GROUP by functional namespace.

critical_auths.title: Unrestricted remote function call execution (S_RFC */16)
critical_auths.remediation: Use UCON/STAUTHTRACE to replace RFC_NAME=* with explicit function modules or groups.

critical_auths.title: Unrestricted background job administrator privilege (S_BTCH_ADM BTCADMIN=Y)
critical_auths.remediation: Remove BTCADMIN=Y from dialog users; restrict to Basis batch administration roles.

critical_auths.title: Unrestricted OS file write access from ABAP (S_DATASET */34)
critical_auths.remediation: Restrict FILENAME to approved interface directories and validate logical file paths (FILE).
